logline: Artyom, a young man from a small town near Samara who has recently moved to Kazan for his first job

family: Sunday lunch at Galina Petrovna's flat near the Kremlin
A birthday tea at Marina's family house in the Old Tatar Sloboda
A video call with Artyom's parents back home near Samara
daily: Morning coffee at Ildar's café on Bauman Street
Shopping for groceries at the Central Market
An evening walk along the Kremlin embankment
A ride on the Kazan metro at rush hour
work: A team stand-up meeting in an office near Black Lake Park
Lunch with colleagues on a bench in Black Lake Park
A business trip by bus to Innopolis
A coffee break in the office kitchen
offices: Registering at a multifunctional service center (МФЦ)
Opening a bank account at a branch on Bauman Street
Getting a library card at the National Library of Tatarstan
Sending a parcel at the main post office
media: Reading the morning news on a Kazan city website
Listening to local radio in a taxi
Watching a TV report about the Kazan Kremlin
Reading posters for an upcoming festival on Bauman Street
exam: Introducing yourself to a new neighbor in the stairwell
Describing your flat to a landlord over the phone
Asking for directions near the Kul Sharif Mosque
Booking a table at a restaurant by phone
curious: The legend of the leaning Söyembikä Tower in the Kremlin
How echpochmak got its triangle shape
The Temple of All Religions on the outskirts of Kazan
Winter ice fishing on the Volga
The island village of Sviyazhsk, reached by a causeway

cafe.title: В кафе
cafe.blurb: Order breakfast at a cozy café on Bauman Street.
cafe.brief: Ildar, the friendly owner of a small café on Bauman Street in Kazan; it is a quiet morning and I come to order, curious about echpochmak and chak-chak
cafe.task: Order a drink and something to eat, ask about one dish, and pay.

way.title: Как пройти?
way.blurb: You're lost near the Kremlin. Ask a passer-by for help.
way.brief: a helpful local near the Kazan Kremlin; I stop you to ask how to get to the Kul Sharif Mosque or the Kremlyovskaya metro station
way.task: Ask where a place is, understand the directions, and thank the person.

colleague.title: Новый коллега
colleague.blurb: Meet a colleague on your first day at work.
colleague.brief: Marina, a designer at a small IT company near Black Lake Park in Kazan; I am the new colleague and we meet in the office kitchen over coffee
colleague.task: Introduce yourself, say what you do, and ask your colleague one or two questions about work.

shop.title: На рынке
shop.blurb: Buy fruit and honey at the Central Market.
shop.brief: a cheerful seller at a stall in the Central Market in Kazan, selling apples, cheese and local honey; I want to buy a few things and ask about prices
shop.task: Ask the price of two items, buy them in specific amounts, and pay.

doctor.title: У врача
doctor.blurb: You've caught a cold. Tell the doctor how you feel.
doctor.brief: a kind general doctor at a city clinic in Kazan; I have come in with a cold
doctor.task: Describe how you feel, answer the doctor's questions, and understand the advice.

family.title: В гостях у бабушки
family.blurb: Sunday lunch at Grandma's. Talk about the family.
family.brief: Galina Petrovna, a warm retired teacher who lives near the Kazan Kremlin; I am your grandchild, come for Sunday lunch
family.task: Talk about your family members, say what they do, and answer Grandma's questions.

station.title: На вокзале
station.blurb: Buy a train ticket to Moscow for the weekend.
station.brief: a ticket clerk at the Kazan-Passazhirskaya railway station; I want a ticket to Moscow for the weekend and ask about times, seats and the price
station.task: Buy a ticket for a specific day and time, and check the platform and the price.

restaurant.title: В ресторане
restaurant.blurb: Dinner with friends at a Tatar restaurant.
restaurant.brief: a polite waiter at a traditional Tatar restaurant in the Old Tatar Sloboda in Kazan; I am having dinner and want your recommendations
restaurant.task: Ask for a recommendation, order a full meal, and ask for the bill.

hotel.title: В гостинице
hotel.blurb: Check in at a hotel near the Kremlin.
hotel.brief: a receptionist at a small hotel on Kremlyovskaya Street in Kazan; I have come to check in
hotel.task: Check in, confirm your booking details, and ask one question about the hotel.

cast.name: Артём
cast.role: The lead, a junior software tester who has just moved to Kazan and is learning the city one street at a time

cast.name: Марина
cast.role: Artyom's cheerful colleague, a designer who grew up in Kazan and loves showing it off

cast.name: Галина Петровна
cast.role: Artyom's grandmother, a retired schoolteacher who lives nearby and feeds him every Sunday

cast.name: Ильдар
cast.role: Owner of a small café on Bauman Street who makes the best echpochmak in town

cast.name: Алия
cast.role: Ildar's curious eight-year-old daughter who asks Artyom endless questions

cast.name: Сергей Николаевич
cast.role: Artyom's patient team lead, a fan of fishing and old Soviet films

places.name: улица Баумана
places.note: The pedestrian street where Ildar's café is and where Artyom walks after work

places.name: Казанский Кремль
places.note: Where Marina takes Artyom on weekends to see the Kul Sharif Mosque and the Annunciation Cathedral

places.name: парк Чёрное озеро
places.note: The quiet park near the office where the team eats lunch on sunny days

places.name: Центральный рынок
places.note: Where Galina Petrovna buys honey, cheese and vegetables and teaches Artyom to bargain

places.name: вокзал Казань-Пассажирская
places.note: The railway station where Artyom arrives, meets visitors and sets off on trips

places.name: Старо-Татарская слобода
places.note: The old Tatar quarter with wooden houses where Marina's family lives and celebrations happen

beats.letters-and-sounds: Artyom arrives at Kazan station, reads the signs letter by letter and greets Marina, who meets him.
beats.who-i-am: On his first day Artyom tells Sergey Nikolaevich and the team who he is, where he is from and what he does.
beats.my-family: At Sunday lunch Galina Petrovna shows Artyom family photos: his parents, his cousins and his uncle in Samara.
beats.where-is-it: Artyom looks for his new office, the bank and the metro, asking where things are on Bauman Street.
beats.what-i-want: At Ildar's café Artyom orders tea and echpochmak, and Aliya explains everything on the menu.
beats.having: Artyom moves into his flat and finds out what it has and what it does not have yet.
beats.counting: At the Central Market Galina Petrovna teaches Artyom to count, weigh and bargain for honey and cheese.
beats.going-places: Artyom learns the city by metro, bus and on foot, going to work, to the market and to the Kremlin.
beats.yesterday: Over lunch by Black Lake Artyom tells Marina what he did at the weekend.
beats.plans: The team plans a weekend on the island of Sviyazhsk: who will buy the tickets, who will bring food, what they will see.
beats.likes-and-needs: Aliya asks Artyom what he likes, what he misses and what he needs for his new flat.
beats.with-friends: Artyom spends an evening with Marina's friends, cooking with them and talking about their jobs.
beats.do-it: Galina Petrovna teaches Artyom to make chak-chak, giving instructions and warnings.
beats.many-things: Marina takes Artyom through the Old Tatar Sloboda, describing the colorful houses, people and shops.
beats.comparing: Artyom and Marina compare Kazan with Samara and Moscow: which is older, bigger, more beautiful.
beats.arriving-leaving: Marina guides Artyom on a walk: out of the metro, across the square, past the Kremlin, and on to a day in the forest by the river.
beats.at-the-doctor: Artyom catches a cold and tells the doctor what hurts, and nobody at work believes he is ill.
beats.would-you: Artyom's parents visit, and he books them a hotel and asks politely for what they would like.
beats.linking-ideas: Artyom explains to his grandmother the people he works with, which friend is which and why he wants to stay.
beats.written-style: Artyom reads a museum guide and a city notice and turns the written style into plain speech for Aliya.
beats.they-say: Ildar hears news that a famous chef is coming to Kazan, and everyone retells it differently.
beats.two-registers: Artyom chats casually with friends on the embankment, then writes a formal letter to his landlord.
